title: reading.slice@1
description: One slice of what a handle names (#63), as deep read --json prints it and a reading job's read tool returns it: at most 8,192 characters by default, and a cursor to continue a cut one.

covers.description: Which part of its source the slice covers, in words.

text.description: The slice: redacted, as the evidence store holds it.

next.description: The cursor that continues it; absent when nothing is left.

messages.description: For a transcript: each message the slice holds, in order.

outside.description: Whether it is no first-hand source: outside content a tool brought, or the agent's own words.

tool.description: The tool whose result it holds, when it holds one.

start.description: Where its text starts in `text`, in UTF-16 code units.
